resourceName: Fujian Shunchang IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Fujian Shunchang IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Shunchang County, Nanping City, Fujian Province of China.
The area of the project activity is 2,945 ha, which distributes in the 14 towns, including 838 sub-compartments spreading over Xiayang Town, Jianxi Town, Yangkou Town, etc. All these departments are state-owned forests and have the legal right to forest ownership. the project area includes state-owned forest land and cooperative forestland redeemed by forest farmers, which are 1,099ha and 1846ha respectively, and both parts of forest land have legal forest rights. The species involved in the project are Masson Pine, Chinese Fir and Hard Broad -Leaved tree.
The project has approximately 2,945 ha commercial forest, whose ages range from middle age to mature forest, most of the broad-leaf trees are nearly mature or mature. Before the implementation of the project, the forest within the project area was designed and planted as commercial forest and logged annually according to the timber logging and managing plan issued by the local forest authority. The main object of the project is to improve the forest coverage rate, protect local ecological environment, reduce carbon emissions, and carbon sequestration by enhance the management level and converse logged to protected forest within the project area. The implementation of the project will result in significant carbon sequestration and improve the sustainable development of ecological system. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 695,287 tCO2e in 30 years starting from 01/01/2017, the average annual emission reduction is 23,176 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 570,136 tCO2e in 30 years, the average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 19,005 tCO2e.
